headline: Kagi launches Gmail-rival email service in public beta
summary: Kagi, known for its paid search alternative and Orion browser, launched a public beta of Kagi Mail, a new email service pitched as a privacy-focused rival to Gmail that also includes AI features.

claims.statement: Kagi launched a public beta of Kagi Mail, a new email service positioned as a Gmail rival.

sources.quote: Kagi announced a public beta of Kagi Mail, a new email service that has "no surveillance, no ads, open standards, and no lock-in."
Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival

claims.statement: The product pitch combines privacy promises with AI features.

sources.quote: The pitch is an unusual combination of privacy promises and AI features.
